guardrails_append: Raw ETF close ratios never drive trend when complete provider pct_chg history is available.
ETF unit splits and consolidations are removed from fund-share changes instead of being treated as subscriptions or redemptions.
Unresolved price adjustment breaks fail closed.
ETF entry requires at least 60 trading days of sector price-cycle evidence.
Rebound/B-wave candidates, secondary-decline/C-wave risk, downtrends, ranges, bases, and late acceleration do not pass the entry gate.
A zero-candidate cash result is valid when no sector is in first impulse, main uptrend, or primary-uptrend pullback.
